title: preprocessing.coverage.assert_actual_lag_within
---



```python
preprocessing.coverage.assert_actual_lag_within(actual, now, max_lag)
```

Raise `CoverageError` if the last published actual is too old.

Corresponds to the second guard in the operational ``assert_coverage``
(script line ~462): the last non-NaN Actual Load observation is older than
``now - max_lag``, indicating ENTSO-E's publication pipeline has stalled.

The comparison is strict (``<``): ``last_actual == now - max_lag`` is a
passing boundary (lag is exactly at the tolerance).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                                           | Description                                                                                                      | Default    |
|---------|------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| actual  | [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`)       | Series of Actual Load (or equivalent) values.  NaNs are stripped before computing the last published timestamp.  | _required_ |
| now     | [pd](`pandas`).[Timestamp](`pandas.Timestamp`) | Reference timestamp representing the current wall-clock time (tz-aware).                                         | _required_ |
| max_lag | [pd](`pandas`).[Timedelta](`pandas.Timedelta`) | Maximum acceptable age of the last published observation. The operational default is ``pd.Timedelta(hours=36)``. | _required_ |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                                                           | Description                                                                                                   |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [CoverageError](`spotforecast2_safe.exceptions.CoverageError`) | When the last non-NaN observation is older than ``now - max_lag``, reporting the observed lag in whole hours. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}


::: {#4161b289 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
from spotforecast2_safe.preprocessing.coverage import assert_actual_lag_within
from spotforecast2_safe.exceptions import CoverageError

now = pd.Timestamp("2026-06-11 12:00", tz="UTC")
idx = pd.date_range("2026-06-10 00:00", periods=24, freq="h", tz="UTC")
actual = pd.Series(range(24), index=idx, dtype=float)

# Passing: last observation is 36 h old, tolerance is exactly 36 h.
assert_actual_lag_within(actual, now, pd.Timedelta(hours=36))

# Failing: tolerance is 35 h but last observation is 36 h old.
try:
    assert_actual_lag_within(actual, now, pd.Timedelta(hours=35))
except CoverageError as exc:
    print(exc)
```
:::
